Join the branch with the other parallel branches at a parallel gateway, with a sequence flow from the wait event into that join gateway.

records.text: reference task "customer waits until bank confirms payment" has no counterpart in the generated model (after parallelGateway "Start payment and address steps"; before parallelGateway "Payment and address steps done")
reference flow task "customer waits until bank confirms payment" -> parallelGateway "Payment and address steps done" is absent from the generated model
reference flow userTask "Enter payment data" -> parallelGateway "Start payment and address steps" is absent from the generated model

confirmation.rule: confirmed when, after it is sent back, the number of errors of the type it was learned from goes down (over its tests) and the new model is kept
